title: Trump-Backed Michigan Candidate Loses Primary to Rival Who Suspended His Campaign
summary: Without running a single ad or filing a campaign finance report, Tom Smith, who had suspended his bid, soundly defeated Amir Hassan, a Navy veteran backed by President Trump.
